title: each way a scoped name in skills_first or mcp can fail validation has its own problem text
source: intended: JITSO v0.2 plan 2.1 (validation texts of scoped names); cloud: names are out of v0.2
intent: The user allowlist approves humanizer, nofile and sprint-testing as skills and engram, undefined and dbhub as servers. Only humanizer and sprint-testing have a SKILL.md, only engram and dbhub are defined in ~/.claude.json. sprint-testing and dbhub are also project names, which a user item may not take.

rows: skill "user:nope" is not in the user allowlist (~/.jitso/jitso.yaml)
user skill "nofile" has no SKILL.md under ~/.claude/skills/nofile
user skill "sprint-testing" has the name of a project skill
mcp "user:nope" is not in the user allowlist (~/.jitso/jitso.yaml)
user mcp "undefined" is not defined in ~/.claude.json
user mcp "dbhub" has the name of a project mcp server
mcp "cloud:Slack": cloud connectors cannot be given to a launched session yet

files..jitso/jitso.yaml:
version: 1
skills: [humanizer, nofile, sprint-testing]
mcp: [engram, undefined, dbhub]
files..claude/skills/humanizer/SKILL.md:

name: humanizer
description: Make text read human.
---

Body.
